Your new company   A growing Managed Service Provider requires a Level 2/3 Support Engineer for a permanent opportunity commencing ASAP, to be based at their Geelong office. The company promotes a collaborative and supportive work environment, offering exposure to leading technologies.     Your new role    In this exciting new role, you will be: 
 
 Providing 2nd & 3rd level support for a broad range of clients. 
 Handling escalations for the level 1 Helpdesk team. 
 Maintaining relationships with clients. 
 Performing technical support of servers, network and hardware. 
 Delivering a high level of customer service. 
 Installing, maintaining and expanding the IT Infrastructure for clients. 
 
   What you'll need to succeed    To be successful in your application, you will need: 
 
 Demonstrated experience of providing level 2 IT support. 
 Sound knowledge of Azure, Windows Server, Exchange, Office 365, VMware / Hyper-V, Hardware and LAN / WAN Networks. 
 A tertiary education in Information Technology as well as Azure, Microsoft, VMware, Palo Alto, Check Point and Cisco certifications are beneficial. 
 Proven experience working for a Managed Service Provider or Consultancy. 
 Current driver's license and access to a car. 
 
   What you'll get in return    Working in an organisation where they develop and grow careers, you will be offered a great salary package, working across a supportive and collaborative team. This organisation prides itself on internal promotion and career development. Do not miss out!

You will manage inventory, supplier relationships, and stock control, while ensuring compliance with food safety, hygiene, and workplace health and safety standards. compliance-related activities  Stay up to date with local council regulations and licensing requirements  Prepare and submit operational reports to senior management  Handle daily administrative tasks Strong organisational and time-management skills   About Company    Secret Harbour Pizza is a busy, well-loved local shop where we serve fresh, hand-stretched pizzas—both traditional and gourmet—along About us

McCarroll Motors is a privately owned multi franchise dealership covering Ford, Kia and lronman 4 X 4 brands. We are located in Mudgee, approximately 3 hours north west of Sydney. If a tree change is in order, Mudgee offers the best of both worlds will all the facilities normally found in a much larger rural community.

* Qualified Motor Mechanic

* A commitment to quality service

* A keen eye for detail

* Franchise automotive dealership experience is preferred but not essential.

Tasks & responsibilities

* Perform diagnosis and rectify mechanical problems
* Working alongside other experienced technicians and closely with our Spare Parts Department
* The position reports to the Service Manager and Dealer Principal

Benefits

* Remuneration package negotiable depending on candidate's experience - $55,000 - $75,000 per year
* Ongoing training and development
* Opportunity for career advancement

result.description: Harman Hospitality group trust  You are a passionate and customer-focused leader who enjoys working in a fast-paced retail environment. You have excellent leadership and organisational skills, understand the importance of authentic customer service, and can effectively manage both daily operations and business growth. You will lead by example, ensuring outstanding customer experiences while maintaining high standards of store presentation, food handling, stock management, and operational efficiency. This is a hands-on leadership role suited to someone who is passionate about Indian food retail, enjoys leading a team, delivering exceptional customer service, maintaining high product quality, and helping build a trusted brand within the local community.   Benefits   Competitive salary and performance incentives  Opportunities for career growth  A supportive leadership team and collaborative culture  Staff discounts and team recognition initiatives    Task & responsibilities   Plan, coordinate, and supervise the daily operations of the Indian sweets and snacks retail store.  Monitor stock levels of sweets, snacks, groceries, beverages, and other specialty products, ensuring timely replenishment and minimal wastage.  Manage inventory with particular attention to products with limited shelf life and seasonal demand.  Supervise, train, and motivate retail staff to deliver exceptional customer service.  Ensure attractive merchandising and presentation of sweets, savouries, gift hampers, and festive displays.  Monitor sales performance and implement strategies to increase customer traffic and revenue.  Coordinate with sweet manufacturers and suppliers to maintain consistent product quality and availability.  Manage customer enquiries, feedback, and complaints professionally to maintain high customer satisfaction.  Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, workplace health and safety, and retail operating standards.  Prepare and monitor store budgets while controlling operational costs to maximise profitability.  Assist in planning and executing promotional campaigns, festive sales, community events, and cultural celebrations such as Diwali, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, Eid, and other seasonal festivals.    Qualification & experience   Previous experience in retail or store management, preferably within a food, supermarket, grocery, sweets, or hospitality environment.  Strong leadership, organisational, and interpersonal skills.  Demonstrated ability to manage inventory, staff performance, and daily retail operations.  Good understanding of customer service principles and retail sales strategies.  Relevant qualification at Diploma level or higher in Retail Management, Business, Hospitality, or a related discipline.  Ability to communicate fluently in  English . Proficiency in  Hindi and/or Punjabi  will be highly regarded due to the store's diverse customer base.  Understanding of Indian sweets, snacks, grocery products, customer preferences, cultural traditions, and seasonal purchasing trends is highly desirable.   About Company     Billa Sweets is a newly established Indian sweets and snacks retail business located in the rapidly growing suburb of Truganina, Victoria. The business has been created to meet the increasing demand for authentic Indian sweets, traditional desserts, festive products, and quality snacks within Melbourne's multicultural western suburbs.        Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $80000-85000   Job Publish:  14-07-2026   Job Expire:  13-08-2026  Apply on:  Retail Manager Job here!
